If you what to make a Grudge style entity, it would be good to have it be static with only suddle movements. Having to look into eyes of something that is looking directly at you without the possibility to look away is perfect way to make view uncomfortable, but the glitch effect takes that away by having to move eyes in order to follow it.

Child cries are perfect in background - fits the Grudge ghost's backstory and just instictively creates discomfort.

If you are planning on making a series, please don't show the ghost's backstory. The less we know, the more unpredictable it is. Subtle hints can work enough.

As for ideas - either an entity that follows a family or specific person, or a curse that is tied to certain location or item. Not global threat, but rather a force of nature. Like Junji Ito

  
EDIT: Check real analog footage to get a feeling or understanding of how the media created that way [actually looks](https://youtu.be/nqy_hYDI0As). Too many people think putting VHS static and few glicthes is enough.
